reviews.title: Good budget psu!
reviews.comment: I know it’s bronze but I’ve had this a couple years now & it’s worked great. I’ve used it with a handful of gpu’s and a couple different CPU’s. Worth noting it ran a 4080 and a 9070xt amazingly as well as a 10700k and a 14900k beautifully. No issues highly recommended.
